title: Water park
content: You enter the realm through the mall As you walk through the halls you encounter a stair case you walk at least 4 staircases but you also have waked down The bottom stair cases lead to a suburban environment and multiple families raising a small farm With chickens, goats and pigs These are multimillion dollar houses that can afford the fields to maintain these animals There’s properties in this neighborhood That your spirit feels like you shouldn’t visit But the abandoned mansion with the gated doors and peach/tan housing you always enter This mansion is filled with multiple rooms with platforms and stairs that you need to remember your own flexibility You can reach rooms that lead deeper into the mansion that are haunted or reach rooms that lead to the casino/hotel
